title: Normalized constant-scalar comparisons for the explicit site tensor
statement: Let (C,J) be a site with C in Type u and morphisms in Type v, let B be a commutative ring in Type(max u v), and write R for its constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let F be restriction of R-module sheaves to constant B scalars [def-sfb-constant-ring-module-restriction]. There is an isomorphism e0 from the constant B-module sheaf to F(R), carrying the image of every constant b to the ring sheafification unit at b. For every pair M,N of R-module sheaves there is an isomorphism F(M) tensor_B F(N) ≅ F(siteTensor(M,N)) [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], where siteTensor is the explicit sheafified sectionwise tensor. Its component on every local pure tensor x tensor y is the explicit module sheafification unit applied to x tensor_R y. No nonzero ring, points, terminal object or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the ordinary normalized monoidal structure on constant scalar restriction. Compose its unit isomorphism with the inverse identification of the fixed tensor unit with the constant B-module sheaf. Apply the inverse unit map to the proposed scalar equation; the inverse identity and Ordinary.unit_hom prove it.

The presheaf monoidal tensor and explicit siteTensorPresheaf are isomorphic by the identity on sectionwise tensors. Sheafify this identity and compose it with tensorObjIsoSheafification. Compose its image under restriction with the ordinary restriction tensorator. Ordinary.tensor_inv identifies the image of a fixed pure tensor with ringPure. The presentation inverse identity cancels tensorObjIsoSheafification, and naturality of the sheafification unit across the identity presheaf comparison gives exactly siteSheafTensorTmul.

lean.statement:
theorem explicit_tensor_comparisons :
    ∃ e0 : (constantSheaf J (ModuleCat.{max u v} B)).obj (ModuleCat.of B B) ≅
      (restriction J B).obj (SheafOfModules.unit _),
    (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (b : B), e0.hom.hom.app U
      ((toSheafify J ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of B B))).app U b) =
        (realizationRingUnit J B).app U b) ∧
    ∀ M N : Modules J B,
      ∃ e : (restriction J B).obj M ⊗ (restriction J B).obj N ≅
        (restriction J B).obj ((SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight N).obj M),
      ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) (y : N.val.obj U),
        e.hom.hom.app U
          ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (sheafToPresheaf J (ModuleCat.{max u v} B))
            ((restriction J B).obj M) ((restriction J B).obj N)).app U (x ⊗ₜ[B] y)) =
          SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul M N U x y
